paper.title_en: Hidden symmetries and the universality of Hawking radiation
paper.abstract_en: Quantum tunneling of particles across a black hole (BH) horizon provides an intuitive interpretation of Hawking radiation (HR), yielding a conceptually simple derivation of the thermal spectrum within a semiclassical framework. However, for BHs obeying the no-hair theorem, usual implementations of the complex-path (Hamilton-Jacobi) method typically rely on approximating the metric near the BH horizon. In this work, we demonstrate that the Hawking spectrum can be derived without such approximations by exploiting gauge invariance in quantum field theory and the separability of the Hamilton-Jacobi (HJ) equation arising from hidden symmetries of these spacetimes. This perspective shows explicitly why the BH behaves as an effective $(1+1)$-dimensional blackbody at the event horizon, provides the conditions needed to extend the HR to higher-spin particles, and offers a framework that can naturally incorporate back-reaction and quantum-gravity effects.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该论文直接处理黑洞热力学核心问题——霍金辐射的推导，提出利用量子场论规范不变性与时空隐藏对称性带来的 Hamilton-Jacobi 方程可分离性，避免近视界近似，并讨论高自旋粒子、back-reaction 与量子引力效应的扩展框架。理论深度与潜在方法学意义较高，属于值得点击阅读的候选。
decision.title_zh: 隐藏对称性与霍金辐射的普适性
decision.abstract_zh: 粒子穿越黑洞（BH）视界的量子隧穿为霍金辐射（HR）提供了一种直观解释，在半经典框架内给出了热谱的概念上简单的推导。然而，对于满足无毛定理的黑洞，复路径（Hamilton-Jacobi）方法的通常实现通常依赖于在黑洞视界附近对度规作近似。在本工作中，我们证明，通过利用量子场论中的规范不变性以及由这些时空的隐藏对称性所产生的 Hamilton-Jacobi（HJ）方程的可分离性，可以在不作此类近似的情况下推导出霍金谱。这一视角明确展示了为何黑洞在事件视界处表现为有效的 \((1+1)\) 维黑体，给出了将 HR 推广到高自旋粒子所需的条件，并提供了一个能够自然地纳入 back-reaction 与量子引力效应的框架。
